bluetooth_confirm.title: Collar found
bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up {name}? Its activity will be tracked whenever the collar is in range. Stock InfiniTime needs no pairing; custom firmware asks you to pair next.

pair.title: Pair the collar
pair.description: Press the button on the watch once. Pairing is open for 60 seconds. Then submit this form to bond with it.

user.title: Pick a collar
user.description: Choose the watch from the Bluetooth devices the Pi can hear. Likely watches are listed first.

data.dog_name: Dog's name (optional, e.g. Kida or Bridget)

error.pair_failed: Pairing failed. Press the watch button again and submit within 60 seconds.
error.not_seen: That address is not in range. Wake the watch, keep it near the Pi, and try again.

abort.already_configured: This collar is already set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No Bluetooth devices are in range. Wake the watch and try again.
